model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';
SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 150 AND price < 300;
SELECT first_name, last_name, hire_date FROM employees WHERE YEAR(hire_date) = 2023;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE quantity < 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories;
SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT first_name, last_name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL;
SELECT first_name, last_name, city FROM customers WHERE city = 'Hamburg';
SELECT department_name, location FROM departments WHERE location = 'Berlin';
SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Laptops';
SELECT DISTINCT first_name, last_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Sales';

SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.status
FROM orders o
JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.employee_id
WHERE e.first_name = 'Julia' AND e.last_name = 'Becker';
SELECT product_id, quantity FROM warehouse_stock WHERE warehouse_location = 'Munich Regional Warehouse';
SELECT product_name, quantity FROM products WHERE quantity > 2;
SELECT product_name, quantity FROM products WHERE quantity < 30;

SELECT o.order_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, o.order_date
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.city = 'Munich';

SELECT li.order_id, li.product_id, li.quantity, li.unit_price
FROM line_items li
JOIN orders o ON li.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled';

SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Audio';

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, d.department_name
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
WHERE d.department_name = 'Fulfillment';

SELECT orders.order_id, customers.first_name, customers.last_name, orders.status
FROM orders
JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE customers.country = 'Germany' AND orders.status = 'completed';
SELECT product_id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE warehouse = 'Hamburg Fulfillment Center' AND quantity > 100;
SELECT product_name, unit_price FROM products WHERE unit_price > 500;

SELECT p.product_name, c.category_name
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Fitness Equipment';

SELECT d.department_name, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON d.department_id = e.department_id
GROUP BY d.department_name;

SELECT product_name, SUM(units_sold) AS total_sold
FROM sales
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY total_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS order_year, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_year;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS laptop_customers FROM orders WHERE product_name LIKE '%laptop%';

SELECT c.category_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name;

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders_handled
FROM employees e
LEFT JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name;
SELECT warehouse_name, SUM(stock) AS total_stock FROM warehouse_stock GROUP BY warehouse_name;
SELECT category_name, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category_name;

SELECT c.category_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM categories c
LEFT JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name;

SELECT first_name, last_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
GROUP BY customers.customer_id, first_name, last_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;

SELECT c.category_name, SUM(p.price * oi.quantity) AS revenue
FROM categories c
JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY c.category_name
HAVING revenue > 5000;
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
SELECT product_name, units_in_stock AS total_units FROM products ORDER BY units_in_stock DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT c.category_name, AVG(p.sold_unit_price) AS avg_sold_price
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
GROUP BY c.category_name;

SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, SUM(s.sale_value) AS smartphone_sales
FROM employees e
JOIN sales s ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id
JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Smartphones'
GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name
ORDER BY smartphone_sales DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
FROM customers c
JOIN payments p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
HAVING total_spent > (
    SELECT AVG(customer_total) FROM (
        SELECT SUM(amount) AS customer_total
        FROM payments
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) AS subquery
)
SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);
SELECT product_name, price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products;
SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE product_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM orders);

SELECT p.product_name, p.price, c.category_name
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE (p.category_id, p.price) IN (
    SELECT category_id, MAX(price)
    FROM products
    GROUP BY category_id
);

SELECT first_name, last_name, total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spend_rank
FROM (
    SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent
    FROM customers c
    JOIN payments p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
) sub;
SELECT order_id, order_value FROM orders WHERE order_value > (SELECT AVG(order_value) FROM orders);

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN stocks s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%laptop%'
  AND w.city = 'Berlin';

SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, p.product_name, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_total
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE c.customer_id = (
    SELECT o2.customer_id
    FROM orders o2
    JOIN order_items oi2 ON o2.order_id = oi2.order_id
    GROUP BY o2.customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(oi2.quantity * oi2.unit_price) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
